says: Acting on all three priorities. The wanderer now stands on the slab itself, smaller, with a short solid cast shadow and three long folds in the robe. The mesas are rebuilt as eroded buttes: caprock, ragged cliff with horizontal strata, talus aprons with gullies, the far ones paler. Stipple now fades from dense by the rocks to almost nothing at the horizon and never runs through the figure. The boulders are shaded with nested curves that wrap their bulk instead of straight diagonals, and the hoodoo stem gets curved bands. The ruled sky is gone; the upper sky is left blank except for two faint cloud strokes.
